books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.description: A man lives alone in an infinite house of statues and tides, keeping careful journals of its halls. As he investigates the only other living person there, the nature of his world, and his own past, comes slowly and devastatingly clear.

books.title: Bird by Bird
books.author: Anne Lamott
books.description: A working novelist's advice on writing and on life, delivered in short, wry chapters. Famous for the "shitty first drafts" chapter, which has talked more people out of quitting than any pep talk.

books.title: The Long Way to a Small Angry Planet
books.author: Becky Chambers
books.description: The patchwork crew of a tunnelling ship take a job that will keep them travelling together for a year. Very little explodes; almost everything is about how these people learn to live with one another.

books.title: Educated
books.author: Tara Westover
books.description: Raised by survivalists who kept her out of school, Westover teaches herself enough to reach university and then has to decide what that costs her. Content note: sustained family violence.

books.title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
books.author: TJ Klune
books.description: A by-the-book caseworker is sent to assess an orphanage of magical children and finds the life he never let himself want. Gentle, funny, and unapologetically kind.
